# pi-glance 0.7.0

- Stash a prompt with `alt+s`; press again to restore or swap. Drafts survive reloads and restarts within the same session.
- Configure the shortcut in `/glance` → Input. Pi keybinding conflicts are checked before saving.
- Git Summary shows changed files and tracked line counts, folding down on narrow terminals. New installs and older configs use Summary.
- Auto fetch refreshes the upstream every five minutes without sign-in prompts. Disable it in Status line → Git.
- Coalesce Git refreshes during tool bursts and retain the last known branch on transient failures.
